sculpt_bench.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_bench.notes: Sculpted low bench: waney-edged slab, four splayed round legs with wedged through-tenons, rails, worn hollow seat, a split held by an iron cramp. Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures (batched prop). Materials MI_Trim_Furniture_wood / MI_Trim_Metal_wood / MI_Trim_Metal_metal as prop_bench.
